summary: Implemented one deterministic offline/paper command that runs the crypto numeric brain chain from fixture scoring to review table to paper order plan. The command emits concise JSON by default and Markdown with --markdown.
limitations: Uses fixture input only; no live markets, prices, or APIs are fetched.
Generated paper order plan is an offline review artifact only; no real order is created.
No runtime integration, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, or additional validation layer was added.
